text: ok I've been on hold for ages and then got told to text so here goes. My sister is 10 months old. Her temp is 38.9. She's been pulling at her ear all evening and crying when she does it so I think it might be hurting. But the main thing I'm worried about is her breathing. It's really fast, like way faster than normal I think, and you can see the skin kind of sucking in under her ribs every time she breathes. She's also making a little grunting noise with it. I'm not sure if that's normal with a temp but it doesn't look right to me. My mum is with her now but she asked me to sort this. Can someone actually get back to us please because we've been waiting a while now.
